description: The PHP extensions this server provides, by tier and variant, and where each form of distribution departs from that. The single source of truth for builds, checks and docs.

spc.note: Build support per OS is taken from static-php-cli 2.8.5 config/ext.json; our own verified exceptions are added on top.

notes.8.4: imap, oci8 and pdo_oci are no longer bundled with PHP; they build from PECL.
notes.8.5: opcache is always compiled in and cannot be left out.

tiers.server: What the server itself needs to run and isolate requests.
tiers.required: What the standard application platform needs to run.
tiers.recommended: Default extensions, every statically linkable database driver, and caching.
tiers.extra: Everything else static-php-cli can build on the platform.
tiers.other: Known, but not built into any variant (development tools, conflicting runtimes, run-time drivers); ext:build --with adds them.

mini.description: Only what the server itself needs: the smallest binary.

lite.description: The server plus everything the standard application platform requires.

standard.description: lite plus the recommended tier: all static database drivers, caching and full image support. The default.

full.description: Everything static-php-cli can build on the platform.

source.description: A build kit, not a binary: the phar, this manifest, the console tool and the static-php-cli recipe, to build any variant locally with qbixctl ext:build.

oci8.why: Oracle Instant Client is a proprietary shared library; it cannot be linked into a static binary.

apt: Download Oracle Instant Client basic and sdk zips from oracle.com and unzip to /opt/oracle/instantclient
dnf: dnf install -y oracle-instantclient-basic oracle-instantclient-devel (Oracle's yum repository)
brew: brew tap InstantClientTap/instantclient && brew install instantclient-basic instantclient-sdk
windows: Unzip Oracle Instant Client and add it to PATH
Download php_oci8.dll for your PHP version from pecl.php.net/package/oci8 and add extension=oci8 to php.ini
docker: Use the image variant that includes the Oracle add-on (see docker.md)

pdo_oci.why: Needs Oracle Instant Client, as oci8 does. Bundled with PHP up to 8.3; from 8.4 in PECL.

apt: Install Oracle Instant Client as for oci8
PHP 8.3 and earlier: build ext/pdo_oci from the PHP source with --with-pdo-oci=instantclient,/opt/oracle/instantclient
dnf: Install Oracle Instant Client as for oci8
docker: Use the image variant that includes the Oracle add-on (see docker.md)

pdo_firebird.why: Needs the Firebird client library at run time, which static-php-cli does not build. (The old interbase extension was removed from PHP in 7.4; pdo_firebird replaces it.)

docker: Use the image variant that includes the Firebird add-on (see docker.md)

sqlsrv.why: Needs Microsoft's ODBC Driver for SQL Server at run time, a proprietary shared library; not shipped.

apt: Add Microsoft's package repository (packages.microsoft.com) and: ACCEPT_EULA=Y apt-get install -y msodbcsql18 unixodbc-dev
apt-get install -y php{v}-dev && pecl install sqlsrv
dnf: Add Microsoft's repository and: ACCEPT_EULA=Y dnf install -y msodbcsql18 unixODBC-devel
dnf install -y php-devel && pecl install sqlsrv
windows: Download the Microsoft Drivers for PHP for SQL Server matching your PHP version and add extension=sqlsrv to php.ini

pdo_sqlsrv.why: Needs Microsoft's ODBC Driver for SQL Server at run time; not shipped.

apt: pecl install pdo_sqlsrv && echo "extension=pdo_sqlsrv" > /etc/php/{v}/mods-available/pdo_sqlsrv.ini && phpenmod pdo_sqlsrv

msaccess.why: Reached through odbc/pdo_odbc and an Access ODBC driver; there is no PHP extension of its own.

apt: apt-get install -y php{v}-odbc odbc-mdbtools (read-only mdbtools driver)
windows: Install the Microsoft Access Database Engine (ACE) redistributable
Enable extension=pdo_odbc and connect with odbc:Driver={Microsoft Access Driver (*.mdb, *.accdb)};Dbq=C:\path\file.accdb

pecl.windows: php_{ext}.dll from pecl.php.net, then extension={ext} in php.ini
